stops.name: Trin
stops.detail: In the gorge lie the stations of Trin, Versam-Safien, and Valendas-Sagogn, which are accessible by road from the villages on the surrounding heights and plateaus.

stops.name: Punt Ruinaulta
stops.detail: At the Trin station, the pedestrian bridge Punt Ruinaulta spans the Rhine.

stops.name: Isla Bella
stops.detail: A hiking trail leads past Isla Bella from Trin and over the railway bridge to Versam station.

stops.name: Burg Wackenau
stops.detail: Wackenau at the castle hill of Wackenau Castle.
